ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p59/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p59/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p59/r2.claim: The Qur'an is a reminder and the Prophet should not bear stubborn people's tantrums: he must deliver it, but cannot force guidance, and hearers choose their fate.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p59/r2.anchor: It is up to them to benefit from it and adopt the right path.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p59/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p59/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p59/r3.claim: God warns people before seizing them to remove their excuse; the Messenger's responsibility is delivery, not coercing acceptance.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p59/r3.anchor: The practice of the Almighty is that before He seizes people He reminds them so that they are left with no excuse

ALUSI-FULL:v29p135/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p135/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p135/r1.claim: Whoever chooses to take heed may do so and thereby gain happiness in both abodes.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p135/r1.anchor: فمن شاء أن يذكره ذكره وحاز بسببه سعادة الدارين

ALUSI-FULL:v29p135/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p135/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p135/r2.claim: The stopping place may be at kallā in both occurrences, at munashshara, and at al-ākhira if it is understood in the sense of illā.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p135/r2.anchor: والوقف على كلا على ما سمعت في الموضعين وعلى منشرة والآخرة أن جعلت كما في الحواشي بمعنى إلا

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r4.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r4.claim: Whoever wills may take the reminder to heart.

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r9.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r9.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r9.claim: Whoever wishes may take heed of it.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r8.claim: Whoever wills may retain the Qur’an in the heart, understand it, and embody its teaching.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r8.anchor: فثبت في صدره وعلم معناه وتخلق به

BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r9.claim: The Qur’an is easy in wording and meaning for its originally unlearned audience; like a fresh sea, reflection yields further meanings although no one reaches its depths.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r9.anchor: خوطب به أمة أمية لا ممارسة لها لشيء من العلوم , فسهل في لفظه ومعناه غاية السهولة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r10.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r10.claim: The human choice implied here does not mean independent control: God created human powers and gave servants choice, but their acts depend on His will.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r10.anchor: وكان الله سبحانه قد خلق القوى والقدر , وجعل للعبد اختيارا

BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r16.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r16.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r16.claim: The sūra’s ending returns to its opening, pairing warning with glad tidings: the sinner may return to obedience and have his lapses covered, under the commands to warn, magnify God, and shun impurity.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r16.anchor: فقد رجع آخر السورة على أولها , وانطبق مفصلها على موصلها , بضم البشارة إلى النذارة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r1.claim: The sūra’s aim is to show the greatness of the Prophet commanded to warn by the greatness of his Sender and God’s complete power, which disclosed knowledge to him.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r1.anchor: مقصودها الدلالة على عظمة المدثر المأمور بالإنذار صلى الله عليه وسلم لعظمة مرسله سبحانه وتمام اقتداره

BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r2.claim: The Qur’an is a great reminder through clear meanings, sweet wording, grand structure, smooth composition, and lofty aims; sincere intent and resolve disclose its hidden secrets.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r2.anchor: هذا القرآن تذكرة عظيمة لما أودعه الله من وضوح المنعاني

BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r3.claim: The willing person remembers the Qur’an by retaining it, knowing its meanings, and taking on its character.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r4.claim: Whether someone is veiled from the Qur’an or receives its disclosures and treasures depends entirely on God’s will.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r4.anchor: وإنما المانع عن ذلك مشيئة الله تعالى

BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r5.claim: God may unveil the Qur’an’s beauties and treasures to a follower and adorn him with it, as He did with Muhammad, whose character was the Qur’an.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p241/r5.anchor: كما كان المدثر صلى الله عليه وسلم حين كان خلقه القرآن

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r4.claim: “Whoever wishes may remember” follows naturally from calling the Qur’an a reminder and resembles the corresponding line in Sūrat al-Muzzammil.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r5.claim: The pronoun may refer to the Qur’an, with the construction understood as “remember by it.”
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r5.anchor: وهو القرآن فيكون على الحذف والإيصال

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r6.claim: Alternatively, the pronoun may refer to God, understood from context despite no prior mention of His name in these verses.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r6.anchor: ويجوز أن يعود إلى الله تعالى وإن لم يتقدم لاسمه ذكر في هذه الآيات لأنه مستحضر من المقام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r7.claim: “Whoever wishes” means whoever wants to take heed may do so through the Qur’an; this invites willing reflection and warns that neglect has no excuse.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r7.anchor: أي من أراد أن يتذكر ذكر بالقرآن وهو مثل قوله آنفا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r8.claim: People possess a will that grounds religious duties and reward or punishment, while their act of remembering remains conditioned on God’s will.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r8.anchor: لا يقع إلا مشروطا بمشيئة الله أن يتذكروا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r9.claim: Ashʿarī theologians call the human will relevant to accountability kasb, while Muʿtazilites call it created capacity; Ibn ʿĀshūr says the formulations are close.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r10.claim: God’s supreme will cannot be resisted or compelled; without its attachment to a servant’s will, the servant does not attain what he wants.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r10.anchor: المشيئة العظمى التي لا يمانعها مانع ولا يقسرها قاسر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r1.claim: When divine will enables obedience and fulfillment of God’s commands, it is called tawfīq.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r1.anchor: وهذه المشيئة هي المعبر عنها بالتوفيق إذا تعلقت بإقدار العبد على الداعية إلى الطاعة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r2.claim: When divine will leaves someone to the misguidance of corrupt ideas and desires, it is called khidhlān.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r2.anchor: وبالخذلان إذا تعلقت بتركه في ضلاله الذي أوبقته فيه آراؤه الضالة وشهواته الخبيثة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r3.claim: When divine will rescues someone from error and illuminates the path of good, it is called luṭf; ʿUmar’s conversion after opposition is an example.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r3.anchor: وإذا تعلقت بانتشال العبد من أوحال الضلال وبإنارة سبيل الخير لبصيرته سميت لطفا مثل تعلقها بإيمان عمر بن الخطاب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r4.claim: The account of God’s guidance and misguidance corresponds to the verse describing God opening or constricting a person’s breast.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r4.anchor: فمن يرد الله أن يهديه يشرح صدره للإسلام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r5.claim: Ibn ʿĀshūr reconciles God’s command with accountability for error through the discussion in 4:78–79, while noting a divine mystery hidden behind promises and warnings.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r5.anchor: هذا حاصل ما يتمخض من الجمع بين أدلة الشريعة المقتضية أن الأمر لله

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r9.claim: The closing statement explains the invitation to remember: remembrance leads to piety, so people should remember and fear God, who alone merits that fear.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p333/r9.anchor: تقوية للتعريض بالترغيب في التذكر والتذكر يفضي إلى التقوى

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r6.claim: Whoever wills may remember the afterlife and act for it, with God's guidance enabling that choice.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r6.anchor: فمن شاء وفقه الله تعالى لذلك ذكر معاده فعمل له

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r7.claim: A person's remembrance of the afterlife and pursuit of salvation occur by God's will; nothing exists apart from His will.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r7.anchor: ثم أخبر تعالى أن ذكر الإنسان معاده وجريه إلى فلاحه إنما هو كله بمشيئة الله تعالى

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r8.speaker: نافع وأهل المدينة وسلام ويعقوب
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r8.anchor: وقرأ نافع وأهل المدينة وسلام ويعقوب: «تذكرون» بالتاء من فوق

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r9.speaker: أبو جعفر وعاصم وأبو عمرو والأعمش وطلحة وابن كثير وعيسى والأعرج
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r9.claim: They read يذكرون with yāʾ; Abu Ja'far is also reported with tāʾ and a doubled dhāl, as if تتذكرون with assimilation.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r9.anchor: وقرأ أبو جعفر وعاصم وأبو عمرو والأعمش وطلحة وابن كثير وعيسى والأعرج: «يذكرون» بالياء من تحت

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414#2/r1.claim: The pronoun refers to the Quran: whoever wishes may remember it, take its admonition, and understand it.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414#2/r1.anchor: الهاء عائدة على القرآن فالمعنى فمن شاء أن يذكر القرآن ويتعظ به ويفهمه ذكره

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414#2/r2.claim: The next verse redirects the mention of will to God’s own will.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414#2/r2.anchor: ثم رد المشيئة إلى نفسه فقال تعالى

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p274/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p274/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p274/r1.claim: A person remembers only if God wills, as affirmed by the statement that people do not will except as He wills.

JISHUMI:v10p7173/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7173/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7173/r4.claim: The verse establishes that a servant chooses, against compulsion theorists.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r19.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r19.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r19.claim: Whoever chooses may remember the reminder, retain it, and make it his concern; its benefit returns to him.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r19.anchor: أن يذكره ولا ينساه ويجعله عينه فعل ، فإن نفع ذلك راجع إليه

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r20.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r20.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r20.claim: The pronouns in ‘it is a reminder’ and ‘remember it’ refer to al-tadhkira in 74:49; masculine forms reflect its sense as dhikr or Qur’an.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r20.anchor: والضمير في { إنه } و { ذكره } للتذكرة في قوله { فما لهم عن التذكرة معرضين } ( المدثر : 49 ) وإنما ذكر لأنها في معنى الذكر أو القرآن

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.speaker: رسول الله
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet promises ten good deeds for each person in Mecca who believed in Muhammad or disbelieved in him to whoever recites al-Muddaththir; no grading is stated.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.anchor: من قرأ سورة المدثر أعطاه الله عشر حسنات بعدد من صدق بمحمد وكذب به بمكة

MUQATIL:74:53-56/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:74:53-56/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:74:53-56/r3.claim: Whoever wills may remember or understand the Qur'an.

BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r10.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r10.claim: Whoever chooses may keep the reminder before his eyes and take heed before reaching the grave, thereby gaining happiness in both worlds.
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r10.anchor: أن يذكره ويتعظ به قبل الحلول في القبر

NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#14/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#14/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#14/r1.claim: Whoever wishes may remember the Qurʾān and not forget it; the benefit returns to that person.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#14/r1.anchor: أي فمن شاء أن يذكره ولا ينساه فعل فإن ذلك عائد إليه

RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r4.speaker: المعتزلة
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r4.claim: The Muʿtazilites interpret God's willing as compelling people and forcing them to remember.
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r4.anchor: قالت المعتزلة : يعني إلا أن يقسرهم على الذكر ويلجئهم إليه

RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r5.claim: Al-Razi rejects the coercive reading: remembrance is negated except when God wills it, so its absence shows that He did not will it; restricting the will to coercion departs from the apparent wording.
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r5.anchor: والجواب : أنه تعالى نفى الذكر مطلقا ، واستثنى عنه حال المشيئة المطلقة

RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r6.claim: The verb yadhakkarun is read with either yāʾ or tāʾ and in both lighter and doubled forms.
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r6.anchor: وقرىء يذكرون بالياء والتاء مخففا ومشددا

RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r7.claim: God is worthy of His servants' reverent fear and obedience, and worthy to forgive their past unbelief when they believe and obey.
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r7.anchor: هو حقيق بأن يتقيه عباده ويخافوا عقابه فيؤمنوا ويطيعوا وحقيق بأن يغفر لهم ما سلف من كفرهم إذا آمنوا وأطاعوا

STUDYQURAN:74:55/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:55/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:74:55/r1.claim: As rendered, remembering means especially acting in accordance with God’s Word in the Quran.
STUDYQURAN:74:55/r1.anchor: As rendered, this verse refers to remembering, particularly in the sense of acting in accord with the Word of God in the Quran.

STUDYQURAN:74:55/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:55/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:74:55/r2.claim: Alternatively, the phrase may mean that whoever wills may remember God.
STUDYQURAN:74:55/r2.anchor: It could also be read as referring to the remembrance of God: “So let him who will, remember Him.”

TAB-FULL:v23p463/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p463/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p463/r1.claim: Whoever wills may heed the Qurʾān and act on its commands and prohibitions, but they remember it only if God wills and grants them ability.
TAB-FULL:v23p463/r1.anchor: يذكروه، لأنه لا أحد يقدر على شيء إلا بأن يشاء الله يقدره عليه

TABATABAI:74:53-56/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:53-56/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:53-56/r2.claim: Whoever wishes may take heed from the Qur'an; it is an invitation offered in a setting of choice, without compulsion.
TABATABAI:74:53-56/r2.anchor: فمن شاء اتعظ به فإنما هي دعوة في ظرف الاختيار من غير إكراه

TABRISI:74:49-56/r14.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:49-56/r14.speaker: author
TABRISI:74:49-56/r14.claim: Whoever wishes may take heed from the Qurʾan, since doing so is within that person's capacity.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r5.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses dhakarahu as taking admonition.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r8.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r8.claim: Whoever wills may remember and take heed from the Quran.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r1.claim: The reminder and warning referred to are the Qur'an's verses.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r1.anchor: Öğüt ve uyarı olduğu belirtilen şey Kur’an âyetleridir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r2.claim: Those who sincerely seek guidance and truth will find what they seek in the Qur'an.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r2.anchor: samimiyet ve iyi niyetle öğüt almak, gerçeği bulmak isteyenlerin, aradıklarını Kur’an’da bulacakları bildirilmiştir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r3.claim: Everything depends on God's will, permission, and enabling; He wills and creates good for one who seeks good and evil for one who seeks evil.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r3.anchor: Kuşkusuz her şey Allah’ın dilemesine, izin ve imkân vermesine bağlıdır. Ama Allah iyilik dileyen için iyiliği, kötülük dileyen için de kötülüğü murat edip yaratmaktadır, uyguladığı kural budur.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r4.claim: The verses present the Qur'an as God's warning, indicate no further book will be sent, and affirm its sufficiency for happiness in this world and the afterlife.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r4.anchor: Âyetler uyarıcı olarak Kur’an’ın gönderildiğini ifade ettiği gibi başka kitap gönderilmeyeceğine, dünya ve âhiret mutluluğu için Kur’an’ın yeterli olduğuna da işaret etmektedir.
